scope: BUCHI design assets surveyed during the design-system skill walkthrough. Not exhaustive — this index tracks only frames we have inspected or linked. Extend as new frames are reviewed.

buchi-components-m3.name: BUCHI Components (M3)
buchi-components-m3.role: Canonical Material-3-based BUCHI design system. Subscribes to Google's Material 3 Design Kit library; overrides M3 tokens with BUCHI brand values under the `Buchi/sys/light/*` and `Buchi/sys/dark/*` taxonomy.

buchi-falcon-app.name: Falcon
buchi-falcon-app.role: Tablet UI for the BUCHI Falcon spray-dryer instrument. Uses a brand-categorical token taxonomy (Primary / Alert-Signal / Gradients-Black / Gradients-Forest-Green) that PREDATES or DIVERGES from the M3 system in buchi-components-m3. Re-grounding to M3 is a future migration, not done in this iteration.
